## About

I am an economist and statistician interested in applied econometrics,
poverty dynamics, labor economics, education, and quantitative methods.

My work combines econometric methods, survey data, statistical modeling,
and machine learning to study economic and public policy problems.

## Research interests

- Applied Econometrics
- Poverty and Inequality
- Labor Economics
- Education Economics
- Survey Statistics
- Machine Learning
